comment: Documented unwired modules tolerated by `wiring_audit.py --strict --tolerated-unwired`. A module landing a real consumer must drop its entry — the run fails on stale exemptions.

entries.reason: Region/anvil interop staged for the sharded store cutover (H10); the store itself is not yet the world backend
WorldState facade staged for the embedding-friendly client split; client-app uses its own world module today

Disk pipeline-cache store is implemented and tested, but the renderer has not yet negotiated wgpu PIPELINE_CACHE or connected load/save at pipeline creation; retained as an explicitly staged alpha4 performance feature
Voxel DDA shadow traversal is experimental renderer infrastructure with no live client-gpu consumer yet; retained as explicitly staged rendering work rather than treated as a production path
Windows/macOS desktop integration helpers are implemented as a platform API but no live shell/UI consumer uses them in alpha4; retained as explicitly staged platform integration
Reversible section-delta primitives are staged core infrastructure for the delta-world save cutover; no production world backend consumes them yet
Versioned vanilla gameplay facts are staged for structural compatibility and worldgen epoch checks; the live server still uses its existing fact tables
Canonical wire envelope helpers are staged shared infrastructure for newer sync/save codecs; existing codecs still carry their own envelopes
CKH1 chunk-hash synchronization is staged alpha sync infrastructure with no live server/client session consumer yet
RMK1/ZTR1 region Merkle synchronization is staged alpha-6 infrastructure with no live relay or world-sync consumer yet
Zero-JVM property extraction is newly staged alpha-6 adapter infrastructure; auto_adapter has not yet connected its extracted properties to bundle synthesis
Structural kernel routing is staged mod-offload infrastructure pending a live feature-description producer
Optional module configuration and lockfile integrity support is staged server-files infrastructure with no live server startup consumer yet
Delta-world generations are staged for the sharded deterministic store cutover; the store is not yet the live world backend
GPU section residency planning is staged renderer infrastructure; the client render loop does not yet consume its eviction/rebake plans
Shape-template geometry reuse is staged meshing infrastructure with no live block-model consumer yet
Planar quad pulling is newly staged renderer infrastructure awaiting integration behind the production terrain pipeline
